name: Moka
source:
A well-endowed barista at the Milk Milk Coffee shop. She loves to take naps at her workplace. She came to Tokyo together with her sister to revitalize the coffee shop – a family business. Even though she doesn't know a thing about making coffee.

Favorite coffee: Strawberry-chocolate mocha.

Specialization: Elaborate latte art.
